name: Shark Up
detailed_description:
Gameplay & Features:

1. Devour smaller creatures and dodge larger predators.

2. Single‑player only, fully offline—no need to connect.

3. 7 stages of growth—unlock new shark visuals and challenge levels.

4. Stage‑based maps with unique fish ecology and terrain features.

5. Satisfying loop: Eat → Grow → New Stage → Unlock Ability → Repeat.

6. Easy controls—just steer and speed, no barriers to entry.

7. Cartoon art style—funny yet fierce shark designs.

8. No microtransactions or extra systems—buy once and enjoy the full game.

Who’s It For:

If you enjoy lighthearted and humorous growth games, relishing the journey from underdog to top predator, Shark Up is your perfect holiday “mental seafood.”

What You Get:

1. Full game (no in‑app purchases)

2. Single-player story growth mode and endless free‑play mode

3. Evolution across 7 shark forms

4. Multiple stages with varied fish AI

5. Local leaderboards and score challenge system

short_description: Control a shark, avoid threats, and devour smaller fish to grow bigger and score higher. Each evolution unlocks new looks and tougher zones. No gear, no menus—just eat to evolve. A fun, intuitive feeding frenzy where your bite rules the sea!
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Turkish, Japanese, Polish, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Korean
